reviews.author: Annette RISING
reviews.text: Jerry Shaw was very perceptive, he was very professional,promp and gave lots of tips. And very reasonable. If i very need help again, he'll be the one i call.

reviews.author: Michael Stone
reviews.text: My water heater went out on a Tuesday morning. I called Shaw, talked to Donna about scheduling and Jerry about my options to replace it efficiently. 23 hours later I’m taking a hot shower. I checked to see what the big box store would charge and Jerry Shaw was 69% LESS in labor! The workmanship was professional plus customer service was phenomenal! Support local businesses guys and let Jerry and Donna Shaw be the people you trust for plumbing. I have for almost 20 years and never had an issue!

reviews.author: Junior Jackson
reviews.text: When I spoke with Jerry he said he could come out and give me an estimate in a couple days...a couple days came and went with no call. How does any self-respecting business man just ignore potential customers? I’ve texted him and got no response and his mailbox is full. This is extremely unprofessional and inconsiderate. If you don’t want the job, have the common courtesy to let people know as we have deadlines to meet, as well. He must be friends with Elvis Blackmon-a guy who just straight up rips you off!
